departure_policies.pullout: latest feasible: leave selected depot at service start minus directed DHD travel time
departure_policies.direct: leave immediately after prior service; add explicit off-depot stationary wait at next service origin
departure_policies.depot_detour: inbound immediately after service, outbound latest feasible to arrive at next service start; fixes the depot charging window
departure_policies.pullin: leave immediately after final service; recharge at selected depot through the 30:00 deadline

modeling_assumptions.direct_wait_policy: auxiliary applies only to off-depot wait; adapter fails closed if a direct wait occurs at a source-flagged depot

native_cases.variant_policy: single source-flagged depot only; not the source two-depot fleet model

native_cases.initial_inventory_policy: every used bus starts at full usable EB-3 inventory (400 kWh)
native_cases.terminal_policy: every used bus returns to its selected depot and must restore full usable inventory by 30:00 (1800 min); terminal opening is 00:00, so all post-pull-in time is available
native_cases.time_representation: source data remains integer seconds; every native minute value is an exact integer or half-minute conversion; no rounding

energy_model.service_energy_formula: 1.20 * source distance km + 16 * source service duration hours
energy_model.movement_energy_formula: 0.96 * source deadhead distance km + 16 * source deadhead travel hours
energy_model.off_depot_stationary_wait_formula: 16 * explicit stationary off-depot wait hours; added as same-place direct-mode leg
energy_model.depot_parked_auxiliary: assumed off per research lead's selected EGG protocol

charging_model.relationship_to_publisher: EGG idealization, not a reproduction of publisher's assumed one charger with four outputs

cost_policy.vehicle_cost_unit: f100 synthetic currency per used bus

preflight_witness_and_dimensions.classification: constructed one-trip-per-bus feasible witness; not optimized

native_cases.variant_policy: single source-flagged depot only; not the source two-depot fleet model

native_cases.initial_inventory_policy: every used bus starts at full usable EB-3 inventory (400 kWh)
native_cases.terminal_policy: every used bus returns to its selected depot and must restore full usable inventory by 30:00 (1800 min); terminal opening is 00:00, so all post-pull-in time is available
native_cases.time_representation: source data remains integer seconds; every native minute value is an exact integer or half-minute conversion; no rounding

energy_model.service_energy_formula: 1.20 * source distance km + 16 * source service duration hours
energy_model.movement_energy_formula: 0.96 * source deadhead distance km + 16 * source deadhead travel hours
energy_model.off_depot_stationary_wait_formula: 16 * explicit stationary off-depot wait hours; added as same-place direct-mode leg
energy_model.depot_parked_auxiliary: assumed off per research lead's selected EGG protocol

charging_model.relationship_to_publisher: EGG idealization, not a reproduction of publisher's assumed one charger with four outputs

cost_policy.vehicle_cost_unit: f100 synthetic currency per used bus

preflight_witness_and_dimensions.classification: constructed one-trip-per-bus feasible witness; not optimized
